risks.note: India is expected to receive a below-normal southwest monsoon in 2026 on potential El Nino conditions, with IMD projecting rainfall at around 92% of the Long Period Average; positive Indian Ocean Dipole conditions could partially offset this. Management argues the farm ecosystem is now more resilient - horticulture penetration, non-farm income, government support, mechanisation, higher MSPs and farm credit - and that the historical correlation between monsoon variability and Company performance has been relatively moderate.
risks.risk: Monsoon and weather dependence of farm demand

risks.note: Commodity prices fluctuated significantly in FY26 due to global supply-demand imbalances, policy uncertainties and geopolitical disruptions. Mitigated through value engineering, supplier negotiations and long-term price contracts, plus hedging under Board-approved foreign exchange and commodity risk management policies.

The West Asia conflict poses a near-term risk to the Indian auto sector through crude oil price volatility, disruption of critical shipping routes such as the Strait of Hormuz and supply constraints in oil-linked raw materials; prolonged uncertainty could heighten inflationary pressure and currency volatility. De-risking relies on localisation, buffers for critical components, supplier diversification, optimised use of high-risk materials and long-term supply contracts.
risks.risk: Geopolitical disruption and crude oil / shipping-route exposure

risks.note: Agricultural tractors above 75 HP and below 25 HP move to TREM Stage V from 1st October 2026; the 25-50 HP segment migrates to TREM IIIAA from April 2028 and the entire 25-75 HP band moves to TREM V from April 2032. Compliance requires ongoing investment in compliant product development; industry leaders also emphasise the need for stable EV-related policy frameworks to support long-range vehicle programmes.
risks.risk: Emission and safety regulation transition (TREM Stage V)

risks.note: International tractor markets saw subdued growth in FY26, with cost-side pressure on farmer profitability dampening farm machinery capex and softening replacement demand particularly in North America and parts of Europe. In Latin America, near-term Brazilian demand was hit by volatile commodity prices, higher financing costs and weather uncertainty, while currency volatility in select emerging markets pressured affordability and delayed farmer investment decisions.

India applies a tax-rate differential between small and large passenger vehicles based on vehicle length, engine size and fuel type, and the Company's flagship products attract higher tax rates. Mitigated by strengthening the lower-tax UV portfolio (XUV3X0, Bolero Neo, Bolero, Thar) and by EVs (XEV 9S, XEV 9e, BE 6, XUV 3XO EV, XUV 400) which attract the least GST among passenger vehicle categories.

Identified in the BRSR material-issues table as a risk: evolving EPR mandates for end-of-life vehicles, plastics, batteries and e-waste create compliance risk and operational challenges compounded by general waste management obligations, and involve increased compliance costs and investment in waste infrastructure and traceability. Addressed through CERO Recycling vehicle takebacks, onboarding lithium-ion battery recyclers and authorised plastic recyclers, used-oil collection via dealerships and supplier engagement.
risks.risk: Resource circularity and Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) compliance

risks.note: Identified in the BRSR material-issues table as a risk: operating in water-stressed geographies exposes the Company to resource scarcity, operational disruption and regulatory restrictions, and water management is described as critical to long-term production stability. Mitigated through rainwater harvesting, Zero Liquid Discharge installations and water recycling initiatives across sites.
